story_type: hurricane hunter inside a Category 5 eye, stadium effect eyewall seen from the cockpit window
hook: This plane was inside the eye of a Category 5 hurricane.
narration: This plane was inside the eye of a Category 5 hurricane.
It was Hurricane Melissa, on October twenty-seventh, 2025, filmed by the crew's own navigator.
The crew was the Air Force Reserve's 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron, the Hurricane Hunters.
Inside the eye the air goes almost calm, and the eyewall rises all around like the sides of a stadium.
That wall holds the strongest winds in the storm, and the only way in or out is straight through it.
In the eye, crews drop sensors on parachutes that measure wind, pressure and humidity all the way down.
On every mission, they flew into Melissa's eye two to four times.
[short pause] The next day, Melissa hit Jamaica with winds of one hundred eighty-five miles an hour.
outcome: After the last mission on October thirtieth, the crews and aircraft returned to Keesler Air Force Base.
title: Inside the eye of Category 5 Melissa
description:
An Air Force Reserve Hurricane Hunter crew from the 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron makes passes through the eye of Hurricane Melissa on Oct. 27, 2025, the day before it hit Jamaica.
